rationale: The Latin anchors *commovere* and *movere* point to a sense of causing agitation, disturbance, or emotional/physical stirring, which aligns best with agitate.v.02 ("cause to be agitated, excited, or roused"). While *movere* can be purely physical, *commovere* strongly implies a rousing or unsettling effect, ruling out the more neutral positional senses (agitate.v.06, stir.v.02) and the political campaigning senses (agitate.v.01, crusade.v.01).
